headline: Bond Market Rebuffs Treasury’s $6 Billion Plan to Reduce Borrowing Costs
context: The 10-year yield rose to its highest level in three years, suggesting investors were underwhelmed by the details of a move to buy back government bonds.

sources.name: The New York Times
